title: t TIME = x/y plane for routing & efficiency

doctrine.rule: Every time we see is imprinted — build, push, switch in/out, Cloudflare, GitHub, membrane.
doctrine.x: channel — where the event routes (cloudflare | github | membrane | local | forgejo | connect)
doctrine.y: phase — what kind of act (build | push | switch_in | switch_out | route | deploy | probe | …)
doctrine.t: the coordinate — UTC instant. Efficiency = work / Δt along a path on this plane.
doctrine.why: Routing choices become visible as trajectories. Shell-wait = long Δt on forgejo. Reincarnate = jump github when forgejo path stalls.

routing_read.prefer_short_dt: github + membrane/connect over forgejo when dt explodes
routing_read.cloudflare_discarnate: long gap between push and hud 200 = Pages intercept
